tax_year.description: The tax year printed in the form's header box, e.g. '2025'

taxpayer_name.description: The name(s) shown on Form 1040, printed in the 'Name(s) shown on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR' box

ssn.description: The taxpayer's social security number from the 'Your social security number' box, exactly as printed

part_i_amti.description: Part I, Alternative Minimum Taxable Income

line_1a_taxable_income_adjusted.description: Line 1a: Form 1040 line 14 less Schedule 1-A line 37. Its value is printed in a small inner box labelled 1a, to the left of the main amount column, not in the right-hand column. As a number without commas. If the box is empty, return null, not 0.

line_1b.description: Line 1b: line 1a subtracted from Form 1040 line 11b. Enter the amount printed in the right-hand amount column for this line, as a number without commas or dollar signs. If the amount cell is empty, return null, not 0: return 0 only when a 0 is actually printed on the line.

line_2a_taxes_or_standard_deduction.description: Line 2a: taxes from Schedule A line 7, or the amount from Form 1040 line 12e. Enter the amount printed in the right-hand amount column for this line, as a number without commas or dollar signs. If the amount cell is empty, return null, not 0: return 0 only when a 0 is actually printed on the line.

other_adjustments.description: Every line from 2b through 2t that has an amount entered. Omit blank lines.

line.description: The line number as printed, e.g. '2g'

description.description: The line's printed description, e.g. 'Interest from specified private activity bonds'

amount.description: The amount entered on the line, as a number; negative if shown in parentheses

line_3_other_adjustments.description: Line 3: other adjustments, including income-based related adjustments. Enter the amount printed in the right-hand amount column for this line, as a number without commas or dollar signs. If the amount cell is empty, return null, not 0: return 0 only when a 0 is actually printed on the line.

line_4_amti.description: Line 4: alternative minimum taxable income, lines 1b through 3 combined. Enter the amount printed in the right-hand amount column for this line, as a number without commas or dollar signs. If the amount cell is empty, return null, not 0: return 0 only when a 0 is actually printed on the line.

line_5_exemption.description: Line 5: the exemption amount entered on line 5 (not the table of thresholds printed beside it). Enter the amount printed in the right-hand amount column for this line, as a number without commas or dollar signs. If the amount cell is empty, return null, not 0: return 0 only when a 0 is actually printed on the line.

line_6_amti_less_exemption.description: Line 6: line 5 subtracted from line 4. Enter the amount printed in the right-hand amount column for this line, as a number without commas or dollar signs. If the amount cell is empty, return null, not 0: return 0 only when a 0 is actually printed on the line.

line_7_tentative_tax_before_credit.description: Line 7: AMT at 26%/28%, or from Part III line 40. Enter the amount printed in the right-hand amount column for this line, as a number without commas or dollar signs. If the amount cell is empty, return null, not 0: return 0 only when a 0 is actually printed on the line.

line_8_amt_foreign_tax_credit.description: Line 8: alternative minimum tax foreign tax credit. Enter the amount printed in the right-hand amount column for this line, as a number without commas or dollar signs. If the amount cell is empty, return null, not 0: return 0 only when a 0 is actually printed on the line.

line_9_tentative_minimum_tax.description: Line 9: tentative minimum tax, line 8 subtracted from line 7. Enter the amount printed in the right-hand amount column for this line, as a number without commas or dollar signs. If the amount cell is empty, return null, not 0: return 0 only when a 0 is actually printed on the line.

line_10_regular_tax.description: Line 10: regular tax from Form 1040 line 16 plus Schedule 2 line 1z, less Schedule 3 line 1. Enter the amount printed in the right-hand amount column for this line, as a number without commas or dollar signs. If the amount cell is empty, return null, not 0: return 0 only when a 0 is actually printed on the line.

line_11_amt.description: Line 11: AMT, line 10 subtracted from line 9; carried to Schedule 2 line 2. Enter the amount printed in the right-hand amount column for this line, as a number without commas or dollar signs. If the amount cell is empty, return null, not 0: return 0 only when a 0 is actually printed on the line.

part_iii_capital_gains.description: Part III, Tax Computation Using Maximum Capital Gains Rates, on page 2. Often left blank.

completed.description: True if any amount is entered on lines 12 through 40 of Part III, false if every line is blank

line_12.description: Line 12: the amount from Form 6251 line 6. Enter the amount printed in the right-hand amount column for this line, as a number without commas or dollar signs. If the amount cell is empty, return null, not 0: return 0 only when a 0 is actually printed on the line.

line_40.description: Line 40: the smaller of line 38 or line 39, carried to line 7. Enter the amount printed in the right-hand amount column for this line, as a number without commas or dollar signs. If the amount cell is empty, return null, not 0: return 0 only when a 0 is actually printed on the line.
